program='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

                if grid[c][r] != 6:
                    out[r][c] = grid[c][r]

                    out[r][c] = grid[31-r][c]
                elif 2 <= c < n and 0 <= 31-c < n and grid[r][31-c] != 6:
                    out[r][c] = grid[r][31-c]
    return out
'''
